source_text: You have quite a taste for art, I see.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp#>.You have quite a taste for art, I see.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp#>.You have quite a taste for art, I see. "

translation: Widzę, że masz wyrobiony gust artystyczny.

source_text: I particularly like this piece. A ballerina in a variation of the attitude pose?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx#>.I particularly like this piece. A ballerina in a variation of the attitude pose?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx#>.I particularly like this piece. A ballerina in a variation of the attitude pose?"

translation: Szczególnie podoba mi się to dzieło. Baletnica w jednej z odmian pozy attitude?

source_text: Very good, 1Hero. A man of some culture, I see.

structure.raw_value: AdHaCl.Very good, 1Hero. A man of some culture, I see.
structure.script_literal: "AdHaCl.Very good, 1Hero. A man of some culture, I see."

translation: Bardzo dobrze, 1Hero. Widzę, że masz pewne obycie z kulturą.

source_text: Haha, some would say I’m a man of culture. Or maybe that was a lucky guess.

structure.raw_value: McFlDeNo3.Haha, some would say I’m a man of culture. Or maybe that was a lucky guess.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDeNo3.Haha, some would say I’m a man of culture. Or maybe that was a lucky guess."

translation: Haha, niektórzy powiedzieliby, że jestem człowiekiem kultury. A może po prostu zgadłem.

source_text: I very much enjoy ballet. This is probably my favorite piece.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.I very much enjoy ballet. This is probably my favorite piece.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.I very much enjoy ballet. This is probably my favorite piece."

translation: Bardzo lubię balet. To chyba moje ulubione dzieło.

source_text: Do you do ballet?

structure.raw_value: McFrDe.Do you do ballet?
structure.script_literal: "McFrDe.Do you do ballet?"

translation: Tańczysz balet?

source_text: Ha, no. I’m not quite that flexible, unfortunately. At my age, that ship has sailed.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOpNo4.Ha, no. I’m not quite that flexible, unfortunately. At my age, that ship has sailed.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOpNo4.Ha, no. I’m not quite that flexible, unfortunately. At my age, that ship has sailed."

translation: Ha, nie. Niestety nie jestem aż tak rozciągnięta. W moim wieku jest już na to za późno.

source_text: Maybe that’s why I enjoy it enough to give it center stage. It inspires me with its display of youthful vigor and poise.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Maybe that’s why I enjoy it enough to give it center stage. It inspires me with its display of youthful vigor and poise.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Maybe that’s why I enjoy it enough to give it center stage. It inspires me with its display of youthful vigor and poise."

translation: Może dlatego tak je uwielbiam i stawiam w centrum uwagi. Zachwyca mnie młodzieńczy wigor i wdzięk.

source_text: Qualities that time erodes.

structure.raw_value: AdSaOp.Qualities that time erodes.
structure.script_literal: "AdSaOp.Qualities that time erodes."

translation: Cechy, które z czasem zanikają.

source_text: I don’t know about that. I feel like you have the natural poise of a strong, mature woman.

structure.raw_value: McFrDe.I don’t know about that. I feel like you have the natural poise of a strong, mature woman.
structure.script_literal: "McFrDe.I don’t know about that. I feel like you have the natural poise of a strong, mature woman."

translation: Nie powiedziałbym. Uważam, że masz naturalny wdzięk silnej, dojrzałej kobiety.

source_text: Under the right circumstances, I’m sure you’d also prove quite vigorous.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Under the right circumstances, I’m sure you’d also prove quite vigorous.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Under the right circumstances, I’m sure you’d also prove quite vigorous."

translation: Jestem pewien, że w odpowiednich okolicznościach także potrafiłabyś wykazać się wigorem.

source_text: Clearly you still have your youth.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp#.Clearly you still have your youth.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp#.Clearly you still have your youth."

translation: Widać, że wciąż jesteś młody.

source_text: I’d better keep an eye on you.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.I’d better keep an eye on you.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.I’d better keep an eye on you."

translation: Będę musiała mieć na ciebie oko.

source_text: As much as I enjoy sharing my passion with you, we better not let our dinner get cold.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.As much as I enjoy sharing my passion with you, we better not let our dinner get cold.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.As much as I enjoy sharing my passion with you, we better not let our dinner get cold."

translation: Choć uwielbiam dzielić się z tobą moją pasją, nie pozwólmy, by kolacja wystygła.

source_text: It’s nice to have company for dinner. I’ve not had company since the last time my daughter visited me.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp#.It’s nice to have company for dinner. I’ve not had company since the last time my daughter visited me.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp#.It’s nice to have company for dinner. I’ve not had company since the last time my daughter visited me."

translation: Miło mieć towarzystwo przy kolacji. Ostatni raz miałam gości, gdy odwiedziła mnie córka.

source_text: You have children?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You have children?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You have children?"

translation: Masz dzieci?

source_text: A son and a daughter. Both about your age, actually.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.A son and a daughter. Both about your age, actually.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.A son and a daughter. Both about your age, actually."

translation: Syna i córkę. Właściwie oboje są mniej więcej w twoim wieku.

source_text: It’s hard to imagine a woman like you having a daughter my age.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’s hard to imagine a woman like you having a daughter my age.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’s hard to imagine a woman like you having a daughter my age."

translation: Trudno uwierzyć, że kobieta taka jak ty ma córkę w moim wieku.

source_text: You’re a charmer. Aren’t you, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.You’re a charmer. Aren’t you, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.You’re a charmer. Aren’t you, 1Hero?"

translation: Ale z ciebie czaruś, 1Hero. Prawda?

source_text: What can I say? Some women age like fine wine.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.What can I say? Some women age like fine wine.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.What can I say? Some women age like fine wine."

translation: Cóż mogę powiedzieć? Niektóre kobiety z wiekiem są jak dobre wino.

source_text: Am I a fine wine, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Am I a fine wine, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Am I a fine wine, 1Hero?"

translation: A ja jestem jak dobre wino, 1Hero?

source_text: Hahaha, I’d say you just might be.

structure.raw_value: McFlOpNo3.Hahaha, I’d say you just might be.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOpNo3.Hahaha, I’d say you just might be."

translation: Hahaha, powiedziałbym, że całkiem możliwe.

source_text: Might be?

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.Might be?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.Might be?"

translation: Całkiem możliwe?

source_text: I’d have to have a taste first to be sure.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I’d have to have a taste first to be sure.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I’d have to have a taste first to be sure."

translation: Musiałbym najpierw spróbować, żeby się upewnić.

source_text: Hahaha, you really are bold, aren’t you?

structure.raw_value: AdFlOpNo4.Hahaha, you really are bold, aren’t you?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOpNo4.Hahaha, you really are bold, aren’t you?"

translation: Hahaha, naprawdę jesteś odważny, co?

source_text: So first looking through restricted Eclipse Guild files, then flirting with your superior.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp#.So first looking through restricted Eclipse Guild files, then flirting with your superior.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp#.So first looking through restricted Eclipse Guild files, then flirting with your superior."

translation: Najpierw zaglądasz do zastrzeżonych akt Gildii Eclipse, a potem flirtujesz ze swoją przełożoną.

source_text: You could end up in some very hot water soon if you don’t watch yourself, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.You could end up in some very hot water soon if you don’t watch yourself, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.You could end up in some very hot water soon if you don’t watch yourself, 1Hero."

translation: Jeśli się nie pilnujesz, możesz wkrótce wpaść w niezłe tarapaty, 1Hero.

source_text: I’m sorry about looking through the Guild files.

structure.raw_value: McSaCl.I’m sorry about looking through the Guild files.
structure.script_literal: "McSaCl.I’m sorry about looking through the Guild files."

translation: Przepraszam, że przeglądałem akta Gildii.

source_text: I had a lead I was following, and needed information. It won’t happen again.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I had a lead I was following, and needed information. It won’t happen again.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I had a lead I was following, and needed information. It won’t happen again."

translation: Podążałem za tropem i potrzebowałem informacji. To się więcej nie powtórzy.

source_text: A lead?

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.A lead?
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.A lead?"

translation: Trop?

source_text: It’s about the Charles Wilkes case.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s about the Charles Wilkes case.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It’s about the Charles Wilkes case."

translation: Chodzi o sprawę Charlesa Wilkesa.

source_text: Wilkes case? The old man who died from a heart attack?

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Wilkes case? The old man who died from a heart attack?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Wilkes case? The old man who died from a heart attack?"

translation: Sprawę Wilkesa? Tego staruszka, który zmarł na zawał?

source_text: I suspect there’s more to it.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I suspect there’s more to it.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I suspect there’s more to it. "

translation: Podejrzewam, że kryje się za tym coś więcej.

source_text: We’ve recently discovered a hidden Guild bunker under the Wilkes mansion. He was likely connected to the Eclipse Guild.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We’ve recently discovered a hidden Guild bunker under the Wilkes mansion. He was likely connected to the Eclipse Guild.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We’ve recently discovered a hidden Guild bunker under the Wilkes mansion. He was likely connected to the Eclipse Guild."

translation: Niedawno odkryliśmy ukryty bunkier Gildii pod rezydencją Wilkesów. Charles prawdopodobnie był powiązany z Gildią Eclipse.

source_text: We think Lillian Wilkes might be carrying on her father’s underworld activities.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.We think Lillian Wilkes might be carrying on her father’s underworld activities.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.We think Lillian Wilkes might be carrying on her father’s underworld activities."

translation: Sądzimy, że Lillian Wilkes może kontynuować przestępczą działalność ojca.

source_text: Myself and Miss Bhatt.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Myself and Miss Bhatt.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Myself and Miss Bhatt."

translation: Pani Bhatt i ja.

source_text: Go on.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Go on.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Go on."

translation: Mów dalej.

source_text: I also think that Duncan Helmer might be trying to restore the Guild under his personal control.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.I also think that Duncan Helmer might be trying to restore the Guild under his personal control.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.I also think that Duncan Helmer might be trying to restore the Guild under his personal control."

translation: Myślę też, że Duncan Helmer może próbować odbudować Gildię i podporządkować ją sobie.

source_text: What reason do you have to believe that?

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.What reason do you have to believe that?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.What reason do you have to believe that?"

translation: Co daje ci podstawy, by tak sądzić?

source_text: Oh, uh, I can’t say for certain the source... I’m still investigating it.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Oh, uh, I can’t say for certain the source... I’m still investigating it.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Oh, uh, I can’t say for certain the source... I’m still investigating it."

translation: Cóż… nie mogę z całą pewnością ujawnić źródła… Wciąż to badam.

source_text: Despite what you’ve heard, I’m happy to report that actually the Guild is well on its way to being history.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp#.Despite what you’ve heard, I’m happy to report that actually the Guild is well on its way to being history.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp#.Despite what you’ve heard, I’m happy to report that actually the Guild is well on its way to being history."

translation: Wbrew temu, co słyszeliście, z przyjemnością informuję, że Gildia wkrótce przejdzie do historii.

source_text: Their existence was an affront to the art world. Thankfully I was able to bring them down.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Their existence was an affront to the art world. Thankfully I was able to bring them down.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Their existence was an affront to the art world. Thankfully I was able to bring them down."

translation: Ich istnienie było zniewagą dla świata sztuki. Na szczęście udało mi się ich pokonać.

source_text: You’ve been working on the Guild case?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.You’ve been working on the Guild case?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.You’ve been working on the Guild case?"

translation: Pracowałaś nad sprawą Gildii?

source_text: Indeed, I have.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Indeed, I have.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Indeed, I have."

translation: Owszem.

source_text: Not too long ago, they started operations here in North Santiva, because of its historical connection with the Casula culture.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Not too long ago, they started operations here in North Santiva, because of its historical connection with the Casula culture.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Not too long ago, they started operations here in North Santiva, because of its historical connection with the Casula culture."

translation: Niedawno rozpoczęli działalność tutaj, w North Santiva, ze względu na historyczne związki miasta z kulturą Casuli.

source_text: Makes sense. There are a lot of Casula artifacts in the area.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Makes sense. There are a lot of Casula artifacts in the area.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Makes sense. There are a lot of Casula artifacts in the area."

translation: To ma sens. W okolicy jest wiele artefaktów Casuli.

source_text: Organizations like the Guild undermine the value of art. They are a stain on humanity.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Organizations like the Guild undermine the value of art. They are a stain on humanity.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Organizations like the Guild undermine the value of art. They are a stain on humanity."

translation: Organizacje takie jak Gildia podważają wartość sztuki. Są hańbą dla ludzkości.

source_text: Especially when it comes to historical artifacts.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.Especially when it comes to historical artifacts.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.Especially when it comes to historical artifacts."

translation: Zwłaszcza jeśli chodzi o zabytkowe artefakty.

source_text: So once I got wind of what was going on, I had to take it seriously.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.So once I got wind of what was going on, I had to take it seriously.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.So once I got wind of what was going on, I had to take it seriously."

translation: Gdy tylko dowiedziałam się, co się dzieje, musiałam potraktować sprawę poważnie.

source_text: An undercover unit was put together under my direction, and infiltrated the Guild.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.An undercover unit was put together under my direction, and infiltrated the Guild.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.An undercover unit was put together under my direction, and infiltrated the Guild."

translation: Pod moim kierownictwem utworzono tajny zespół, który przeniknął do Gildii.

source_text: That couldn’t have been easy to set up.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.That couldn’t have been easy to set up.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.That couldn’t have been easy to set up."

translation: To nie mogło być łatwe do zorganizowania.

source_text: It took some work. But eventually, we became very successful, and brought in federal agencies to assist.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.It took some work. But eventually, we became very successful, and brought in federal agencies to assist.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.It took some work. But eventually, we became very successful, and brought in federal agencies to assist."

translation: Wymagało to sporo pracy. W końcu odnieśliśmy sukces i poprosiliśmy o pomoc agencje federalne.

source_text: Now the Guild is in shambles.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.Now the Guild is in shambles.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.Now the Guild is in shambles."

translation: Teraz Gildia jest w rozsypce.

source_text: But people are concerned because of all the news they’re hearing about the Guild.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx#.But people are concerned because of all the news they’re hearing about the Guild.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx#.But people are concerned because of all the news they’re hearing about the Guild."

translation: Ludzi niepokoją jednak wszystkie doniesienia na temat Gildii.

source_text: Which is why I’m doing an interview tomorrow with Channel 4 News.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.Which is why I’m doing an interview tomorrow with Channel 4 News.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.Which is why I’m doing an interview tomorrow with Channel 4 News."

translation: Dlatego jutro udzielę wywiadu dla Channel 4 News.

source_text: The Guild is in their final death throes. High profile arrests around the state have given rise to rumors and the people are afraid.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.The Guild is in their final death throes. High profile arrests around the state have given rise to rumors and the people are afraid.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.The Guild is in their final death throes. High profile arrests around the state have given rise to rumors and the people are afraid."

translation: Gildia dogorywa. Głośne aresztowania w całym stanie wywołały plotki i strach wśród ludzi.

source_text: The Guild is all but dead and it's now our job to calm the public.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.The Guild is all but dead and it's now our job to calm the public.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.The Guild is all but dead and it's now our job to calm the public."

translation: Gildia praktycznie przestała istnieć, a teraz musimy uspokoić opinię publiczną.

source_text: But what if something is still going on? We still haven't arrested Duncan Helmer, right?

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.But what if something is still going on? We still haven't arrested Duncan Helmer, right?
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.But what if something is still going on? We still haven't arrested Duncan Helmer, right?"

translation: A jeśli coś wciąż się dzieje? Przecież nadal nie aresztowaliśmy Duncana Helmera, prawda?

source_text: The man is in hiding and it won't be long before he too has nowhere to run.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.The man is in hiding and it won't be long before he too has nowhere to run.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.The man is in hiding and it won't be long before he too has nowhere to run."

translation: Ukrywa się, ale wkrótce i jemu zabraknie dokąd uciec.

source_text: I can see you're eager to impress, and that's why I brought you here tonight.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.I can see you're eager to impress, and that's why I brought you here tonight.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.I can see you're eager to impress, and that's why I brought you here tonight."

translation: Widzę, że chcesz zrobić wrażenie. Właśnie dlatego zaprosiłam cię tu dzisiaj.

source_text: The public needs reassurance. You and I are going to give it to them.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.The public needs reassurance. You and I are going to give it to them.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.The public needs reassurance. You and I are going to give it to them."

translation: Opinia publiczna potrzebuje zapewnień. Damy im je razem.

source_text: Me?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Me?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Me?"

translation: Ja?

source_text: I want you to join me for the interview.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp#.I want you to join me for the interview.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp#.I want you to join me for the interview."

translation: Chcę, żebyś dołączył do mnie podczas wywiadu.

source_text: We’ll make you the face of the crackdown on the Guild.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.We’ll make you the face of the crackdown on the Guild.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.We’ll make you the face of the crackdown on the Guild."

translation: Zrobimy z ciebie twarz rozprawy z Gildią.

source_text: Me? I haven’t even been working on the case…officially. Why make me the face?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Me? I haven’t even been working on the case…officially. Why make me the face?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Me? I haven’t even been working on the case…officially. Why make me the face?"

translation: Ja? Przecież oficjalnie nawet nie pracuję nad tą sprawą… Czemu mam być jej twarzą?

source_text: Because you’re a good-looking man, 1Hero, cool and confident. Your very presence will inspire confidence.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Because you’re a good-looking man, 1Hero, cool and confident. Your very presence will inspire confidence.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Because you’re a good-looking man, 1Hero, cool and confident. Your very presence will inspire confidence."

translation: Bo jesteś przystojny, spokojny i pewny siebie, 1Hero. Sama twoja obecność doda ludziom otuchy.

source_text: Wait, so basically I’m just there to look good for the cameras?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Wait, so basically I’m just there to look good for the cameras?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Wait, so basically I’m just there to look good for the cameras?"

translation: Zaraz, czyli mam tam po prostu dobrze wyglądać przed kamerami?

source_text: These chiseled features. This manly face.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp#.These chiseled features. This manly face.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp#.These chiseled features. This manly face."

translation: Te wyraziste rysy. Ta męska twarz.

source_text: The camera will love you. The public will love you.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.The camera will love you. The public will love you.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.The camera will love you. The public will love you."

translation: Kamera cię pokocha. Publiczność też.

source_text: But you also have a drive that I rarely see. I know you won't disappoint me.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.But you also have a drive that I rarely see. I know you won't disappoint me.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.But you also have a drive that I rarely see. I know you won't disappoint me."

translation: Masz też zapał, jakiego rzadko się widuje. Wiem, że mnie nie zawiedziesz.

source_text: You will join me for the interview, won’t you?

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.You will join me for the interview, won’t you?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.You will join me for the interview, won’t you?"

translation: Dołączysz do mnie podczas wywiadu, prawda?

source_text: I’m happy to help serve the public interest.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’m happy to help serve the public interest.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’m happy to help serve the public interest."

translation: Chętnie pomogę służyć interesowi publicznemu.

source_text: That’s what I like to hear, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.That’s what I like to hear, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.That’s what I like to hear, 1Hero."

translation: I to chciałam usłyszeć, 1Hero.

source_text: If it goes well, who knows, perhaps something more will come of it.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx#.If it goes well, who knows, perhaps something more will come of it.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx#.If it goes well, who knows, perhaps something more will come of it."

translation: Jeśli dobrze pójdzie, kto wie — może wyniknie z tego coś więcej.

source_text: Something more?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Something more?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Something more?"

translation: Coś więcej?

source_text: You’ve got potential, 1Hero. This could just be the beginning of your long career.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.You’ve got potential, 1Hero. This could just be the beginning of your long career.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.You’ve got potential, 1Hero. This could just be the beginning of your long career."

translation: Masz potencjał, 1Hero. To może być dopiero początek długiej kariery.

source_text: I’ve never been on TV before.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I’ve never been on TV before.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I’ve never been on TV before."

translation: Nigdy wcześniej nie występowałem w telewizji.

source_text: I’m certain you’ll do well.
